bio.text: Kyle Mullica, a Democrat, represents District 24 (Adams County) in the Colorado State Senate.
He took office in the Senate in January 2023 after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 34) from 2019 to 2023, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Thornton, Colorado, and earned a bachelor's degree in real estate and finance from the University of Denver in 2008.
His career experience includes working as an emergency medical technician and as a housing specialist with the Denver Housing Authority, and he has served on the Northglenn city council.
